summary: Himax Technologies, a Taiwan-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on November 5, 2026 carrying its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release. Q3 revenue was $246.8 million, up 8.5% sequentially, with gross margin of 34.2% and after-tax profit of $18.6 million, or 10.7 cents per diluted ADS, above the 8.0-10.0 cent guidance range. Fourth-quarter guidance calls for revenue down 22%-26% quarter-over-quarter on abrupt automotive TDDI and DDIC order corrections, flat-to-slightly-up gross margin, and profit per diluted ADS of 4.5-6.5 cents. No transaction, ownership, or strategic-review terms were disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings update with no deal terms and no risk-arb angle.
